business_problem: DNB needed a scalable data platform to process nationwide 5G telemetry and cost data because rapid rollout and real-time network optimization demanded faster analytics at much lower unit cost.
solution_summary: Digital Nasional Berhad uses Databricks Data + AI Platform, Delta Lake, Databricks Workflows, and Databricks Notebooks to support 5G network analytics and cost-optimized data pipelines. DNB needed a scalable data platform to process nationwide 5G telemetry and cost data because rapid rollout and real-time network optimization demanded faster analytics at much lower unit cost. In practice, the implementation stores or organizes core datasets in Delta Lake, governs access and lineage with Unity Catalog, coordinates repeatable workflows with Databricks Workflows, runs transformation or AI logic on Databricks Data + AI Platform, and delivers outputs through Power BI. Streaming operational telemetry and business events are consolidated into Delta Lake; pipeline execution is coordinated with Databricks Workflows; Databricks Data + AI Platform applies analytics or model logic; results are surfaced through Power BI. The case study reports 70% and Increased data pipeline performance 5G,...
business_outcome: Digital Nasional Berhad reported 70% and Increased data pipeline performance 5G, improving 5G network analytics and cost-optimized data pipelines with measurable gains in cost reduction, scalability, and customer experience.
architecture_clues: Uses a medallion-style data layering pattern to separate raw, cleaned, and refined data.
Uses serverless or elastic compute so capacity can scale up and down with workload demand.
Centralized governance and lineage are enforced through Unity Catalog.
The platform is designed for near-real-time or streaming analysis rather than batch-only reporting.
evidence_quotes: Building the foundation for the 5G revolution
Building the infrastructure for scalable 5G deployment
Empowering collaboration and innovation with a unified data platform
